records.quote: Example 4.1. Suppose there are two systems, say system-I and system-II. Let each system have three components which are connected in series. Denote the components of system-I as I1 , I2 and I3 and those of system-II as II1 , II2 and II3 . Let the failure times of I1 , I2 and I3 have NP(0.5, 0.1), NP(0.5, 1) and NP(0.5, 9) distributions, respectively. Further, let the failure times of II1 , II2 , and II3 have NP(0.5, 0.1), NP(0.5, 4), and NP(0.5, 6) distributions, respectively. Clearly, (0.1, 1, 9) ⪰m (0.1, 4, 6). Thus, as an application of Corollary 3.1, system-II is preferable to use, since its lifetime has smaller variance.
